sources.environment: transcribed from ladder.sh gpu_env(), meep_env(), do_meep and do_digest
sources.gpu_rows_and_digest: the 2026-09-28 dry-run log ladder_dryrun_priority_only.log (the GPU commands are not recorded in the rows)
sources.ledger: ladder_rows.jsonl (110 entries; the binding decision writes no ledger line)
sources.meep_rows: environment.argv of each MEEP row (rows_r<N>.jsonl), prefixed with the launcher part of the ledger's launcher_line

what: The 111 rows of the 2026-09-28 A6000 ladder (ladder_2026-09-28_b), in plan order, with each row's command as it ran, placeholders substituted for the paths, stamp and times. The test runs timing_ladder.py --dry-run --json under a6000_2026-09-28_b.params and compares under the equivalence stated in docs/development/timing.md.
